wiki_text: On 21 April 2026, CNOOC's Zhuhai Golden Bay ('绿能港') LNG Phase 2 was placed into full operation, comprising five 270,000 m3 full-containment storage tanks. With Phase 2 online, the terminal's total annual LNG processing capacity rose to about 7 mtpa, making it the largest LNG storage-and-transshipment base in South China.

The under-construction PetroChina (Kunlun) Fuqing terminal in Fujian comprises three 200,000 m3 storage tanks. Per the receiving-station documentation, the current phase ('本期') has a nameplate of 3.0 mtpa (300万吨/年), while the facility (berth + regasification) is built to an ultimate receiving capacity of 6.5 mtpa (650万吨/年). It adds 375 million m3 of gas storage and up to ~33 million m3/day of regasification, and is expected to start up in early 2027.

PetroChina's Jiangsu (Rudong) LNG terminal Phase 4 expansion broke ground on 24 June 2025 (total investment RMB 1.66 bn). It adds one 200,000 m3 LNG storage tank, +17.5 million m3/day of regasification/transmission, and +3.25 mtpa (新增接卸能力325万吨/年) of receiving capacity; first cargo readiness was targeted for end-2025/early-2026 and full operation for 2029. After the expansion the terminal's annual receiving/storage/gasification/delivery capacity reaches 10 mtpa.
